questions.description: Path (relative to the manifest) of the question set. Every question it contains MUST carry a `criteria` block with both branches — the check refuses to run otherwise. Measured: dropping criteria took detection from 8/18 to 3/18 and abstention on healthy files to 100%.

ask.description: Question id inside that set whose verdict decides this check. Exactly one: this capability asks one question, not a panel. Measured: a five-question fan-out summed in code did not beat one question on our corpus.

expect.description: The verdict that means nothing fired. The opposite verdict is the only judgment that produces a red.

facts.description: REQUIRED. Executable (relative to the manifest) run once per file. It prints a JSON object of deterministic facts the code resolved on jev's behalf — the pointers jev cannot follow — and may print `"applicable": false` to drop a file before any call is made. Measured: without resolved facts the same 10 hollow tests scored 0/10 with 10/10 abstentions; with them, 17/18 detected.

mode.description: shadow: records every verdict and grants and blocks NOTHING — where every check starts. tripwire: a confident verdict against `expect` turns the check red; everything else is green. There is deliberately no `gate`: a capability whose green would mean "verified" cannot be built on a model that abstains, and an abstention routed to an agent costs more than the agent check it replaces.

pin_model.description: Model id recorded with every verdict, matched by prefix. A dated id (typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917) turns a silent model rotation into an abstention instead of a changed answer.
